summary:
Status: 1 of 6 concepts generated (V-A). 20 of 180 credits spent by this work. Generation is paused for review; the other five slots are empty on purpose.

V-A verdict: does not pass as briefed. The finish, face and silhouette are a clear step up from the original, but the image turned Velynx into a four-legged cat, dropped the glyph tile, and the dark body almost disappears on the dark card at 48 px. Details under the image.
velynx-A: Pass: painted 2D finish, sly half-lidded face, real joints and weight, chest gem, glyphs built from lines and dots (no letters), leaf tail, 48 px silhouette reads instantly, glow 3.2% (budget 10%), 84% frame height. Fail: walks on all fours instead of standing upright (changes Velynx's identity and drifts toward Nyxara, the Epic Shadow fox); glyph tile missing (only a stray glyph floats at lower left); body nearly vanishes in the 48 px colour view because the rim light is too weak; ear notch faint, no cheek tufts, ordinary paws instead of long fingers; no warm key light.
